post.title: URGENT: production checkout broken, need a dev TODAY - $150
post.body: Our Next.js store's checkout throws a 500 on the payment step since this morning's deploy. We are losing orders. I can give repo access. Need someone online right now. $150 for a fix, more if it takes long.

analysis.summary: Fix a 500 error on the payment step of a Next.js store's checkout after a deploy; same-day, $150.

expect: conveys it can look at it today / start now only if the evidence supports availability
does not claim it can fix it in a stated time
